name: sampada
description: Sampada — track your investments (India + US) and full personal finances in one place.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "green,cyan" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && cd web && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd web/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:android:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd web/android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cd web && npx cap open ios
